observations: Photo 0 shows a white and beige sewing machine on a speckled countertop. The machine has a large handwheel on the right, a foot pedal, and a metal plate with text on the front. The machine appears to be in used condition with some visible wear and dust.

Photo 1 shows the same sewing machine from a different angle, revealing more of the front panel. The machine has a black control panel with a dial and a small window. The handwheel and foot pedal are visible. The machine appears to be a vintage model, possibly from the 1960s or 1970s.

The machine has a metal plate with text on the front, but the text is not legible in either photo. The seller claims it is a 'solid New Home vintage sewing machine', but the photos show signs of use and wear.

claims.claim: A solid New Home vintage sewing machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: The photos show a sewing machine with visible wear and dust, consistent with use. The brand and model are not legible, so the 'solid New Home' claim cannot be verified. The 'vintage' claim is plausible but not confirmed by the photos.

claims.claim: This is more than a basic...
claims.evidence: The seller's text is cut off; no further details are provided. The claim about 'more than a basic' cannot be verified from the photos alone.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation, including the needle moving and the motor running smoothly.

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden mechanical or electrical faults.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the internal components, including the motor, belt, and needle bar, to check for wear or damage.

risks.risk: The machine may not be compatible with standard power outlets or may require specific voltage.
risks.proof: A photo of the power cord and plug, and a label showing voltage and frequency specifications.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the brand and model label on the machine.
A video showing the machine in operation.
A close-up photo of the internal components and power cord.
A photo of the power plug and any voltage specifications.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
